subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The ______ mistake these couples made was not spending enough time seriously planning for a lifetime together in marriage.
solution:
The correct answer is **"egregious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"egregious"** can be used in the blank to emphasize the severity or remarkably bad nature of the mistake made by the couple. (जोड़े द्वारा की गई गलती की गंभीरता या उल्लेखनीय रूप से खराब प्रकृति पर जोर देना)
 
• In this context,** "egregious"** highlights that the mistake was not just a minor oversight but a glaring, outstanding error with serious consequences.
 
• It conveys a sense of the mistake being extremely noticeable and deserving of strong criticism.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: *The **egregious**__ mistake these couples made was not spending enough time seriously planning for a lifetime together in marriage.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Credulous: **willing to believe or trust too readily, especially without proper or adequate evidence; gullible. (बहुत आसानी से विश्वास करने या विश्वास करने को तैयार, खासकर उचित या पर्याप्त सबूत के बिना; आसानी से धोखा खानेवाला)
 
• **Enigmatic: **mysterious and difficult to understand. (रहस्यमय और समझने में कठिन)
 
• **Sporadic: **not done or happening regularly. (अनियमित (रूप से किया गया या होने वाला))
